people.name: Sarah

translations.web: They asked him, “Where is Sarah, your wife?” He said, “There, in the tent.”
translations.bsb: “Where is your wife Sarah?” they asked. “There, in the tent,” he replied.
translations.kjv: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.
translations.asv: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.
